extracted.intended_audience: persons seeking to intervene in or protest a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) docket (potential intervenors/protesters, members of the public, landowners, Tribal members, environmental justice communities)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and requirements for filing motions to intervene or protests in a FERC docket (here: an initial market-based rate filing that includes a request for blanket Section 204 authorization). Covers filing rules, deadlines, service, electronic filing, and where to get help or view documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: File with FERC in accordance with Rules 211 and 214
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person desiring to intervene or to protest should file with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission ... in accordance with Rules 211 and 214 of the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure (18 CFR 385.211 and 385.214).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing must be submitted to the Commission (888 First Street NE, Washington, DC 20426). Follow the procedural requirements of 18 CFR 385.211 (intervention) and 385.214 (protests).

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve a copy of the motion to intervene or protest on the Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone filing a motion to intervene or protest must serve a copy of that document on the Applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure proof of service and include the Applicant as a recipient of the filed pleading so that the Applicant receives timely notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet the specified deadline for protests regarding blanket authorization
rubrics_metrics.description: The deadline for filing protests with regard to the applicant's request for blanket authorization, under 18 CFR part 34, of future issuances of securities and assumptions of liability, is July 25, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File before the stated deadline; late protests may be untimely or rejected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify scope of protest: blanket Section 204 authorization (18 CFR part 34)
rubrics_metrics.description: This supplemental notice notes that the application includes a request for blanket authorization, under 18 CFR part 34, of future issuances of securities and assumptions of liability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protests or interventions about this docket should address the applicant's request for blanket Section 204 authorization where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use FERC Online electronic submission encouraged
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission encourages electronic submission of protests and interventions in lieu of paper, using the FERC Online links at http://www.ferc.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic filing is preferred; follow the eFiling workflow on FERC Online for submission and docketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create and validate an eRegistration account to eFile or be listed as contact
rubrics_metrics.description: To facilitate electronic service, persons with internet access who will eFile a document and/or be listed as a contact for an intervenor must create and validate an eRegistration account using the eRegistration link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Register and validate the eRegistration account before attempting to eFile; then select the eFiling link to log on and submit the intervention or protests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative filing methods for persons unable to file electronically
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons unable to file electronically may mail similar pleadings to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, 888 First Street NE, Washington, DC 20426. Hand delivered submissions in docketed proceedings should be delivered to Health and Human Services, 12225 Wilkins Avenue, Rockville, Maryland 20852.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not using eFiling, submit by mail or hand delivery as instructed. (Note: the hand-delivery address appears as provided in the notice; confirm current practice if uncertain.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Access full text and documents via FERC eLibrary
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission provides an opportunity to view and/or print the contents of this document via the Commission's Home Page. From the Commission's Home Page this information is available on eLibrary. The full text of this document is available on eLibrary in PDF and Microsoft Word format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To access this document in eLibrary, type the docket number excluding the last three digits of this document in the docket number field.

rubrics_metrics.name: User assistance and contact information for filing and eLibrary
rubrics_metrics.description: User assistance is available for eLibrary and the Commission's website during normal business hours from FERC Online Support at 202-502-6652 (toll free 1-866-208-3676) or email ferconlinesupport@ferc.gov. Public Reference Room contact numbers and email are also provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the provided phone numbers or email addresses for help with eFiling, accessing documents, or other procedural questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Public Participation (OPP) assistance and outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission's Office of Public Participation (OPP) supports meaningful public engagement and can help members of the public access information and navigate Commission processes. For public inquiries and assistance with making filings such as interventions, comments, or requests for rehearing, the public is encouraged to contact OPP at (202) 502-6595 or OPP@ferc.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OPP can assist landowners, environmental justice communities, Tribal members and others with filing and participation when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify FederalRegister.gov XML against official edition for legal research
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a 'Web 2.0' version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register ... those relying on it for legal research should verify their results against an official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar on govinfo.gov for the official electronic format; only official editions provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
